organisations.what_they_do: Negotiates AI terms into film, TV, commercial, audiobook and video game contracts; lobbies Congress and state legislatures (it backed California's law requiring disclosure of AI-generated performances in advertising); enforces contract terms for members.
organisations.newcomer_action: Sign the NO FAKES Act petition today (open to the public, not just members); if you are a member, report any unauthorised AI use of your voice or likeness to the union.
organisations.volunteers: yes — members through locals and committees
organisations.tips: yes — members can report contract violations to the union
organisations.scale: Large union (around 160,000 members) with real bargaining power and a proven willingness to strike over AI.
organisations.caution: Its ask is control and consent over likeness, not limits on AI capability. The NO FAKES Act is contested by some digital rights groups (including EFF) as a broad new IP right that could restrict speech — you are picking a side in that argument by signing.

organisations.name: Writers Guild of America (WGA West/East)
organisations.the_ask: AI cannot write or rewrite literary material, cannot be credited, and cannot be used to undermine writers' credit or compensation — terms won in the 2023 Minimum Basic Agreement after a 148-day strike.
organisations.what_they_do: Negotiates and enforces the MBA's AI provisions; maintains Know Your Rights guidance on AI; provides legal services to members; runs a violation reporting route.
organisations.newcomer_action: If you are a member and a studio used AI on your material, file through Report a Violation. If you are not, read the AI Know Your Rights page — it is the clearest published example of enforceable AI contract language anyone has won.
organisations.tips: yes — Report a Violation, members only
organisations.geography: United States (film, TV and new media).
organisations.scale: Mid-sized union with outsized leverage in its industry.
organisations.caution: Protections apply only to work covered by the MBA — non-union writing, and most AI training on already-published scripts, is not covered. Enforcement depends on writers actually reporting.

organisations.name: International Federation of Journalists (IFJ)
organisations.the_ask: AI in the media must serve ethically-produced journalism, comply with the Global Charter of Ethics, and be governed by negotiated standards rather than imposed by employers.
organisations.what_they_do: Issued IFJ Recommendations on the Use of Artificial Intelligence (June 2024) with global unions, and adopted a Global Framework Agreement on Artificial Intelligence in the Media (May 2026). Coordinates an AI working group across affiliated national unions.
organisations.newcomer_action: Join or contact your national journalists' union and ask them to apply the IFJ Recommendations in your next collective agreement — the IFJ works through affiliates, not individuals.
organisations.geography: Global — affiliates in 148+ countries representing about 600,000 journalists.
organisations.scale: Large federation, small secretariat.
organisations.caution: No individual membership — everything runs through your national union. Framework agreements are only as strong as each affiliate's ability to enforce them locally.

organisations.name: National Union of Journalists (NUJ)
organisations.the_ask: AI must not be used to cut journalism jobs or degrade editorial standards; its use should be negotiated with the union, with transparency and protection of journalists' work.
organisations.what_they_do: UK and Ireland journalists' union: chapel-level negotiation over AI in newsrooms, industrial action where AI is used to justify job losses (Mirror journalists balloted for strike action over AI-linked job threats), parliamentary work on AI in journalism, and an AI policy for members.
organisations.newcomer_action: If you are a journalist, join the NUJ and raise AI at your chapel; ask your employer for its AI policy in writing.
organisations.volunteers: yes — members only, through chapels and branches
organisations.scale: Mid-sized union (roughly 30,000 members).
organisations.caution: UNVERIFIED: the NUJ website blocked automated access, so the specific AI policy page URL and current wording could not be confirmed — only nuj.org.uk itself is given, and the 2026 industrial action is from third-party reporting (Personnel Today, Nieman Lab). Confirm directly. Route in is membership.
